notes: The ASV reorders the verbless clause (Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the nations) against the Hebrew order; units are reordered and discontinuous accordingly (rule 25).
Because that is one compound subordinator rendering the single יַעַן and fuses under rule 30; rule 55 does not reach it, since a conjunction does stand in the clause.
כְּ takes the supplied copula of the prepositional predicate (rule 49) and heads on like of the compound like unto.
הַגּוֹיִם carries a written article, so it takes the the standing before its own word, while בֵּית takes a supplied one (rule 29).
